# ankra_cluster_k3s_disabled_components (Resource)

The k3s packaged components the platform keeps disabled on a running k3s cluster Ankra provisions (`ankra cluster k3s-disabled-components set`), on top of the provider shape's own defaults, for example `traefik` on a cluster that brings its own ingress. A change is reconciled within minutes by restarting k3s on one control plane at a time; control planes already carrying every entry are not touched. kubeadm and Scaleway clusters are refused. Destroy leaves the list as it is, so a component kept off stays off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_k3s_disabled_components" "prod" {
  cluster_id = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
  components = ["traefik", "servicelb"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `components` (Set of String) Components kept disabled: `coredns`, `servicelb`, `traefik`, `local-storage`, `metrics-server` or `runtimes`.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_kind` (String) Kind of the cluster, resolved from the platform; it selects the API lane.
- `id` (String) The cluster id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_k3s_disabled_components.prod 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666
```
